propositions: A one-time backfill script measures cyclomatic complexity and clone counts at sampled historical commits using lizard and jscpd tools, then writes snapshots with those metrics to the metrics store.
Each snapshot must be timestamped with the sampled commit's ISO date (from git show), not the backfill run wall-clock time, to preserve historical trends.
If a measurement tool is absent or errors for a commit, that commit is skipped non-fatally and logged; the backfill continues for remaining sampled commits.
All written snapshots are tagged with source=snapshot and confidence=high to distinguish backfilled deterministic output from other data sources.
The test suite stubs measure_tree to avoid requiring external tool installation, verifying that 3 sampled commits yield 3 snapshots each with integer complexity and clone_count keys.
